name: recipientName
description: What to call the person being invited: the name the lead typed, or their address when no name was given

name: inviterName
description: Who put them on the booking. Always supplied, because an unexplained message about a safari from a company the reader has never dealt with reads like something to delete

name: tripName
description: The trip they have been added to, so somebody travelling twice knows which

name: portalUrl
description: Their own link to the trip page. They verify their own address from there before any figure is shown, so this message carries no code and no session
